note: One site is one harness run. Synthetic sites use RoadLab and read no lidar. Map sites build only the 500 m chunks the rect touches, plus a neighbour chunk where a sample is within 40 m of a chunk edge. They do not build the rest of the Twin Falls map. The strategy-0 baseline built 4 chunks for cell A and 2 chunks for cell C. Cell A also instances the Perrine bridge model.
unsupported_by_strategy_0: downtown curbs, 2.4 m sidewalks, continental crosswalks, ADA ramps
signal heads, stop bars, and 6 m / 12-15 m corner-return arcs
dev-area map-edge exit pad (strategy 0 only pads the Twin Falls boundary x<=5, x>=4995, z>=-5, z<=-7995)
3 m benches on a rock cut taller than 8 m
0.8 m concrete barrier as its own asset (a guard wall is emitted when the stamped drop exceeds 2.5 m)
approach-slab abutment fill and the Perrine deck joint (lab bridge parapets do emit)
cul-de-sac gravel apron and end-of-road sign

sites.notes: Whole RoadLab. Nominal roads sit in x 100..700, z -2200..-1600. The rect is wider so the 50 m exits (x 750, z -2250) and the cul-de-sac bulb are inside it. Builds the four synthetic chunks (0,-5), (1,-5), (0,-4), (1,-4). No lidar tile is read.

NW downtown grid, diagonal, bus bay centreline. Curbs, sidewalks, crosswalks, ADA ramps and the shelter pad are not supported by strategy 0. Chunks (0,-5) and, if the south edge is within 40 m of z=-2000, (0,-4).

Signalised arterial, 2-to-4 lane roads, cross street, exits 50 m past the dev-area edge. Signals, stop bars and 12-15 m returns are not supported by strategy 0. Chunks (0,-5), (1,-5) and possibly (1,-4).
S-curve, hairpins, T, Y and 6-leg, scaled from the strategy-lab layout. Corner arcs are not supported by strategy 0. Chunks (0,-5) and (0,-4).
Canyon Springs analogue: 10% grade, 13 m hairpins, ~25 m rock mass, fill side, flat pad. Benches are not supported by strategy 0. Chunk (0,-4).

Rim drop over 30 m, bridge with 19 m deck-kind approach tails, parapets on the span, lane-closure centreline, freight rail, 4.9 m vertical pair. Concrete barrier, abutments, crossing, underpass structure and closure furniture are not supported by strategy 0. Chunks (0,-4) and (1,-4).
12 m cul-de-sac bulb and the service road. Apron, end sign and gate are not supported by strategy 0. Chunk (0,-4), and (1,-4) if the service road reaches it.
Bridge approach and visitor lot. Real lidar. The strategy-0 run built chunks (6,-13), (6,-14), (7,-13) and (7,-14), and instanced the Perrine bridge model. Not the whole map.
Canyon Springs Grade. Real lidar, hi-res canyon chunks. A handful of chunks, not the whole map.

Downtown junctions. Real lidar, low-res tiles with the 1 m paint corridor. The 400 m square sits in one z-row, so the strategy-0 run built only chunks (4,-4) and (5,-4). Chunk (4,-4) is the slow one. Not the whole map.
Blue Lakes (US-93) and Addison. Real lidar. A handful of chunks, not the whole map.
Addison off the east map edge. Real lidar. Includes the strategy-0 exit pad when the road end is inside the built chunks.
US-93 off the north map edge. Real lidar. The rect crosses z=-8000, so the exit past the boundary is in the site.
Canyon Rim Rd. Real lidar. Rim barrier and the drop sit in this rect.
Regression pin (3153, -6143). The chunk that contains the pin is built, not the whole map. Cone pushes include this pin.
